summary: Iteration 8: verified the confidence string->float coercion fix. 19/19 pytest backend tests passed (POST /api/meals with confidence 'medium'/'low'/'high'/'very high'/'moderate'/'unsure'/'0.75'/null/numeric all return 200 with correctly coerced float persisted; POST /api/presets with 'high' -> 0.85; nutrition estimate returns numeric confidence; presets rename+log, CSV export, summary/monthly, deficit/monthly, settings/activity regressions all pass). Full frontend E2E on the public URL: short meal ('2 eggs + 1 toast') and the user's original long meal both estimated and SAVED with no nutrition-error toast; meal-count went 1 -> 2 -> 3 and daily calories updated to 1026 kcal (long meal 524 kcal / 56.4g protein, non-zero macros). Meal-input focus regression (snap back to today) still works. Test meals/presets created were cleaned up.

issues: Changing the selected day (previous-day-button) silently discards a freshly generated estimate (App.js line 75 setEstimate(null) on dateKey change), so the 'estimate ready then navigate to past day then save' path is unreachable. Not a defect for the reported bug, but the user loses an AI estimate (and 120s wait) with no warning.

action_items: Optional: preserve (or warn about) the pending estimate when the user changes the selected date, instead of silently clearing it.

Optional cleanup: saveMeal spreads the whole estimate object (including note/breakdown) into POST /api/meals; these extras are silently dropped by Pydantic - consider sending only the persisted fields, and persisting 'note' if it has value.
critical_code_review_comments: The confidence coercion mapping is duplicated 3x (MealCreate, PresetCreate, estimate endpoint) - extract one shared helper/AnnotatedType to keep behaviour consistent (DRY).

Other LLM numeric fields (calories/protein/etc.) are still coerced with bare float() in the estimate endpoint; if GPT returns '250 kcal' as a string with units the endpoint raises and returns a generic 502. Consider a tolerant numeric parser there too.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ prefixed meals/presets created for pytest and E2E; all deleted via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter8.py. Pre-existing user meals on 2026-08-23/24 untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported bug (422 float_parsing on confidence:'medium') is fixed and cannot be reproduced. Run 'pytest /app/backend/tests/test_confidence_fix.py' for regression; run 'python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_iter8.py' after any E2E to remove TEST_ data. Note the LLM sometimes returns numeric confidence (0.82 observed), so the string case must stay covered by the parametrized unit-level payload tests rather than relying on live LLM output.
rca_of_the_issue: GPT-5.4 returned confidence as a string ('medium'); MealCreate/PresetCreate typed it as float causing 422 float_parsing, surfaced in UI as 'Could not save this meal.'. Fix (field_validator mode='before' + mapping, plus coercion in the estimate endpoint) verified for all string/numeric/null variants.
